blurb: LGS Recreation offers a variety of community education and recreation programs including classes, camps, and facility rentals. They provide indoor and outdoor facilities for events and activities, with policies for rentals and cancellations. The organization also hosts special events and offers sponsorship opportunities to support their programs.
